class_evidence: Two datasets built by the authors from Notre Dame campus traffic (Sec. II, p.2): Packets (346,620 instances, 2,106 alerts) and Destinations (4,080 instances, 147 alerts) (Table I, p.2), both treated as intrusive vs not intrusive (Sec. II, p.2). Cluster-SMOTE was run only on Packets with 3 and 5 k-means clusters (Sec. V-A, Fig. 4, p.5); on Destinations the minority formed one cluster (Sec. V-B, pp.5-6).
reduced_multiclass: No benchmark multiclass dataset; SNORT attack-type labels are collapsed to intrusive vs not (Sec. II, p.2).
smote_explanation: k-means is run on the minority examples only and SMOTE is applied separately inside each cluster, after which original and synthetic minority points are merged (Sec. III-C, p.4). The interpolation partner therefore always comes from the seed's own cluster; seeds, the SMOTE rate per cluster and uniform placement on the segment are as in SMOTE (Sec. III-B, p.3; Sec. V-A, p.5).
flags: Evidence for Cluster-SMOTE comes from one dataset (Packets); on Destinations clustering collapses to one cluster, i.e. plain SMOTE. Number of clusters set by the user; SMOTE k not stated.

class_evidence: Algorithm defined for labels y in {1,-1} (Sec. II, p.1323). Artificial 2-class Gaussian set (Fig. 1, p.1324) and 5 UCI datasets used as two-class problems (Table I, Sec. III-A, pp.1324-1325): Vehicle, Pima, Vowel, Ionosphere, Abalone. A multiclass extension is described (Sec. III-D, p.1327) but never run.
reduced_multiclass: Vehicle (4 classes): van vs the rest (p.1324). Vowel (11 classes): first vowel vs the rest (p.1325). Abalone (29 classes): only class 18 vs class 9 kept (p.1325). Pima and Ionosphere are natively two-class.
smote_explanation: ADASYN keeps the SMOTE generator: a partner is drawn from the seed's K nearest minority neighbours and the point is seed + lambda(partner - seed), with K = 5 in the experiments (Eq. 5, p.1324; Sec. III-C, p.1325). What changes is allocation: the total G = (ml - ms) beta is shared out as g_i proportional to the share of majority points among each seed's K neighbours (Eqs. 2-4, pp.1323-1324), instead of an equal number per seed.
corrections: Category, Core and decision point confirmed. Evidence should list three reductions (Vehicle, Vowel, Abalone), not only Vehicle.
flags: Seeds with no majority neighbours get g_i = 0, effectively dropping them as seeds (could also count as Seed selection). Multiclass extension in Sec. III-D is not run.
